blocks.content:
President’s Rule can be imposed when constitutional machinery fails in a State.

• Recommended by Governor
• Approved by Parliament
• Initially valid for 6 months
• Maximum duration – 3 years (with conditions)
President’s Rule can be imposed when constitutional machinery fails in a State.

items: Article 356 relates specifically to the imposition of President’s Rule due to failure of constitutional machinery.
Note the duration limits: Initial validity is 6 months, while the absolute maximum duration is 3 years (with conditions).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: President’s Rule is invoked upon the failure of constitutional machinery in a State.
The process is initiated via recommendation by the Governor.
It must be approved by Parliament to take effect.
The rule is initially valid for 6 months and can extend up to a maximum of 3 years under specific conditions.
